mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates a contraction in both manufacturing and housing sectors, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both INDPRO and RSAFS decline by more than 1% from their 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over the past 6 months indicates strong housing market activity, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS has increased by more than 1% from its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) of more than 50,000 persons signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS monthly change is less than -50 (thousands).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals that monetary tightening is dampening housing demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0), a decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) below 104.0 over the past month signals an imminent supply shock, which disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0 and INDPRO monthly change < -1.0.
